title: Quarterly Business Goals
content_summary: Research three business ideas, develop forecast, prototype website, make marketing plan.
source_note: Summary of accessible Notion test page, not a full-fidelity block export.
content:
The following are sample business goals for the next three months.
Goal 1: Complete market research for three business ideas.
Goal 2: Develop a basic financial model.
Goal 3: Build a simple business website prototype.
Goal 4: Create a marketing plan with a realistic budget.
Goal 5: Review progress and identify improvement opportunities.
Success metrics:
- Three completed market research summaries
- One financial forecast
- One working website prototype
- One marketing plan
End-of-quarter review: Evaluate results and decide which business idea is most promising.
